subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Place value to 20
source.subtopic: Decompose two-digit numbers into multiples of ten and ones (e.g. 16 is 10 and 6; 19 is 1 ten and 9 ones; 20 is 2 tens and 0 ones)

show.line: Sixteen is one ten and six ones. Twenty is two tens and no ones. Tens and ones make every number!

rounds.prompt: One ten-stick and seven ones. What number is it?
Nineteen is one ten and how many ones?
Two tens and no ones. What number is it? Say it.
Tap the number that is one ten and six ones.
Count the sweets. One bag of ten and some loose. How many?

hints: Count the ten-sticks first. Then the ones.
Teen numbers are one ten and some more. Twenty is two tens.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! One ten and eight ones.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One ten and eight ones. Eighty!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! One ten and eight is eighteen. Eighty is eight tens.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count on from ten. Eleven, twelve, up to eighteen!

parent_line: Can break numbers to 20 into tens and ones.
